content.title: Guidelines for Alternate Materials, Methods and Design Review
content.summary: The City of Arvada has established guidelines for the review and approval of alternate materials, designs, and construction methods, allowing for modifications to the building code under specific conditions. The Building and Fire Officials can approve alternatives if they meet safety and effectiveness standards, and applicants must submit a formal request with supporting documentation. Currently, there is no fee for submitting these requests, promoting innovative construction practices within the community.
content.body:
In order to formalize a more predictable approach for developing and reviewing alternate materials, designs, and methods of construction as well as requests for modification of the code, the following guidelines have been developed to apply for an alternative means and methods design review and a modification request.  The provisions of Arvada Building and Fire Codes are not intended to prevent the installation of any material or to prohibit any design or method of construction not specifically prescribed by this code, provided that any such alternative has been approved. The Chief Building Official and/or Fire Official shall review design submittals for compliance to the adopted codes and procedures.

## Steps to submit a formal request

1. Alternative Materials, design and methods Requirements: The City of Arvada Code provides the Building Official and the Fire Official with the authority to approve any alternate material, design, or construction method if the Building Official or Fire Official determines the following:
   1. That the proposed alternate material, design, or construction method is satisfactory, and that the material, design, or method offered is, for the purpose intended, at least the equivalent of that prescribed in the Code in quality, strength, effectiveness, fire resistance, durability, and safety
   2. That sufficient evidence has been submitted to substantiate any claims that may be made regarding the use of any proposed alternate material, design, or construction method.
   3. Please be aware that we do not have the authority to waive the code or provide a variance of code.
2. Modifications of Code Requirements: The City of Arvada Code provides the Building and Fire Official with the authority to grant modifications of the code where the Code Official(s) determine the following:
   1. A practical difficulty in carrying out the provisions of the code is demonstrated and the strict letter of the code is impractical.
   2. The modification is in compliance with the intent and purpose of the code and does not lessen health, accessibility, lie and fire safety or structural requirements.
   3. Please be aware that we do not have the authority to waive the code or provide a variance of code.
3. **How to Apply: [**Fill out the Alternative Materials, design, methods and Modifications form**](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/63346) and provide necessary documentation and resources to demonstrate compliance. Address all communications to:**[**[email protected]**](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#791b0c10151d10171e091c0b14100d0a39180b0f181d1857160b1e)
4. Next Steps: The code official(s) shall respond in writing, stating the reasons the alternative was not approved or approved, within a reasonable time after filing such request.

## Application fee

At this time there is no fee to submit an alternative means and methods application request or modification request. We feel this is a cost savings that we can provide to our community, a way that we can help designers and contractors in utilizing alternative approaches to their construction projects and in so doing helping promote the use of new methods and materials for construction and creative innovations.

## Common requests for such alternatives and modifications

An application should still be filled out for such requests, so that we can collect the appropriate documentation.

- **A2L’s and required shafts:**The existing Codes were written before the EPA mandated the use of A2L refrigerants, and the Code language has not been updated. It is understood that the 2027 IMC will remove the required shafts. In the meantime, the use of Chapter 11 of the 2024 IMC (used in its entirety), combined with the exception in ASHRAE 15-2024 provides an approved Code path to remove the rated shaft requirement.
- **Diamond Piers:**We have accepted the use of Diamond piers in lieu of caissons/ piers/ footings for deck construction in the past, where all other pertinent code requirements are followed and where the most current ICC ES report along with the third party "Colorado Code Compliance Information" documentation, is provided. This decision of course is subject to change if proper compliance is not demonstrated.
- **Requests for use of code requirements from newer editions of model codes or future proposed adopted codes:**As codes are updated, newer innovations in the code are developed. So the use of a newer code edition or requirement is sometimes acceptable. Additionally, when new codes are making their way through the code adoption process, requests for use of a future code section pending ordinance approval, is sometimes acceptable.
